# Villa 181, Emerald Hills — Dubai Hills Estate — BlackOak Real Estate

> A contemporary family home of over 21,000 sq ft in Emerald Hills, Dubai Hills
> Estate, finished in stone, oak and brass and arranged around a sculptural
> spiral staircase. A basement entertainment level is reached by car lift;
> a rooftop gym, spa and jacuzzi look across the golf course to the Downtown
> skyline. For sale at AED 89,000,000. Marketed by BlackOak Real Estate.

## Property facts

- Address: Villa 181, Emerald Hills, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Asking price: AED 89,000,000
- Built-up area: 21,045 sq ft (1,955 m²)
- Plot: 13,665 sq ft (1,270 m²)
- Bedrooms: 5 + 1 ground-floor guest suite · 9 bathrooms
- Staff: 2 en-suite staff quarters
- Parking: 5 spaces, car lift to basement car gallery
- Levels: Basement (5,576 sq ft) · Ground (4,984 sq ft) · First (5,630 sq ft) · Roof (4,855 sq ft)
- Interior design: contemporary modern
- Proximity: Downtown 20 min · Palm Jumeirah 20 min · Dubai Marina 25 min

## Living

- Formal living, formal dining, family living & show kitchen, back kitchen & laundry
- Ground-floor guest suite · office
- Basement entertainment lounge, marble bar, pool table, media / cinema room, wine cellar
- Car gallery via car lift · sunken courtyards

## Bedrooms (first floor)

- Principal suite with his & hers dressing rooms (988 sq ft)
- Master suite 2 (547 sq ft) · three further bedroom suites
- Family lounge · open-air inner courtyard · north and south terraces

## Wellness & outdoors

- Rooftop gym & spa · rooftop jacuzzi with skyline and golf views
- Outdoor swimming pool & garden · outdoor kitchen & BBQ
- Sunken courtyards & water features · reflecting pool at the entrance

## Specification

- Lutron home automation · Dali (internal) and Bowers & Wilkins (external) audio
- Mirage & Florim Italian porcelain · natural oak and engineered grey oak timber floors
- Tundra Grey stone and marbles · Fiandre porcelain · Philip Jeffries wallcoverings · Tabu veneer
- Dornbracht mixers · Villeroy & Boch sanitary ware · ABB satin nickel wiring accessories · Euro Art handles
